title: Conditional kappa = 0.001297375468897877: response retiming and stage-conditioned donor flags (+0.05929% over #483)
body:
This adds `research/tensor-syndrome-portfolio/`, a standalone source-bound construction and offline replay package.

**Conditional kappa = 0.001297375468897877**, exactly `1297375468897877/1000000000000000000`: **+0.059291495% over #483** (`0.001296606691405309`). The bit supplier binds. This is a whole-family result; it does not claim to exceed #480's `0.001372550159367980`, which uses the distinct disputed cross-copy admission.

## Mechanism

1. **Response-preserving injection relocation.** Search the cosets of the transported target-response map, retaining only immutable-source rewrites. Move source5's injection into helper452 earlier to frame480; reconstruct the literal inverse cleanup. Equal nonzero responses preserve the target on every input, including dirty helpers. The actual witness simplifies to commuting additions into one receiver. In each invocation ranks1 and3 are replaced by rank4, strictly improving the recurrence moment for every exponent in(0,1). Deletion-only and insertion-only controls both fail.
2. **Stage-conditioned nested donor inventory.** Choose the one-upgrade provider at stages2,4,6,8 in every replica and the eleven-upgrade provider elsewhere. Their residual-width inventories fit different idle windows differently. Each of88 complete calls names its provider, exact word/program hashes, entrance frames and explicit isometry map. Every one of62,920 residual occurrences remains whole on one family; no cross-family split or independence shortcut enters the construction.

The crossover combines coding/control response kernels with compiler register allocation. Response-preserving retiming and heterogeneous dispatch are not claimed as newly invented mathematics: earlier gate retiming and our R740 portfolio already existed. The new concrete construction is their stage-conditioned application to R715 nested donor flags, with the new source-injection witness. The price is computed from the complete emitted mixed program, never by adding gains.

Python3.11+, SymPy, C++17 and Boost headers are required. The frozen replay needs no optimizer or network. Default mode rebuilds the complex supplier; explicit completed-complex reuse requires the exact prior receipt plus87 implementation and17 output hashes and produces a distinct receipt. A completed reuse run is not represented as a fresh complex replay. GitHub CI is separate and is not claimed passed.

## Research retained for future workers

The package includes sufficient response-coset and stage-composition arguments, explicit witnesses and controls, native syndrome-search source/results, failed higher-arity searches, the complex observability screen, and a larger-replica nomination. The84-replica two-provider screen gave only about5.9e-9 extra bit saving before retiming and is not part of the achieved bound. Fourteen complex scalar-cancellation pairs left the paid profile unchanged. An initial screening double-count of an old packet delta was caught against the exact baseline and corrected before admission; it is documented rather than counted as a result.

Source-level inspirations include Mathlib's kernel-fibre identity, installed binary-syndrome sources and earlier tensor response reconstruction; no new Lean kernel audit or literature-priority claim is made. All inherited all-size supplier/compiler, mutable-basis, target-label, complete dirty invocation, compressed-window, restored-work, precision and analytic contracts remain conditional. No unconditional multiplication theorem or global optimality claim follows.
